hook.text: 4 missed calls from Mum. Is “later” promised to you?

end.text: 4 missed calls from Mum. Is “later” promised to you?
end.gold: Call her this morning. Before your tea goes cold.

captions: Your phone keeps count. In red.
8:12 a.m. Sunday. The kettle starts to hiss.
You typed “busy, call you later.” Four times.
Then a voice note. Four seconds. Her voice.
“Nothing important. I just wanted to hear you.”
You leave the tea. You press call.
She picks up on the first ring. As always.
Twelve minutes. She laughed twice. You'd forgotten that laugh.

post.caption:
4 missed calls from Mum. Is “later” promised to you? 🤍

“Every soul will taste death.” (3:185)

Call her this morning. Before your tea goes cold. She only wanted to hear you.
